title: Harborline Service Level Agreement for Web Hosting Plans: Uptime Commitment and Provisioning Time
content:
**1. Figures of this agreement.** For Web Hosting Plans the following figures apply per tier.

| Figure | Harborline Starter | Harborline Plus | Harborline Pro | Harborline Business | Harborline Cloud 4 | Harborline Cloud 8 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Monthly uptime commitment, percent | 99.9 | 99.9 | 99.9 | 99.9 | 99.95 | 99.95 |
| Credit per started 0.1 percentage point of uptime below the commitment, percent of the plan's monthly fee | 5 | 5 | 5 | 5 | 5 | 5 |
| Largest uptime credit for one calendar month, percent of the monthly fee | 50 | 50 | 50 | 50 | 50 | 50 |
| Days after the end of the affected calendar month within which an uptime credit can be claimed, calendar days | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 |
| Elapsed hours after the order within which a paid plan is provisioned | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 4 | 4 |

**2. Meaning of the figures.**

(a) The uptime commitment is the monthly uptime the plan's server is committed to.
(b) The per-step credit is a percentage of the plan's monthly fee credited for each started 0.1 percentage point by which uptime falls below the commitment.
(c) The cap is the largest uptime credit for one calendar month, as a percentage of the monthly fee.
(d) The claim figure counts calendar days after the end of the affected calendar month.
(e) The provisioning figure counts elapsed hours after the order.

**3. Steps of shortfall (hypothetical readings against a 99.9 percent commitment).** A month measured at 99.86 percent falls 0.04 points short, which is one started step; a month at 99.79 percent falls 0.11 points short, which is two started steps.
